package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestInitialAllocationMigrationFailsClosedAndRetainsEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	up, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/017_diagnostic_initial_allocation_checkpoint.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"initial_allocation_hash IS NOT NULL", "jsonb_typeof(initial_allocation_json)='object'", "IS TRUE", "initial allocation checkpoint is immutable", "BEFORE UPDATE"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", want)
		}
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/017_diagnostic_initial_allocation_checkpoint.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(down), "RAISE EXCEPTION 'initial allocation evidence exists'") {
		t.Fatal("rollback must preserve evidence")
	}
}
